2608.03626.title: A Security-Oriented Lifecycle Model for Large Language Model Systems
2608.03626.paper_summary: Large language models are being integrated into critical infrastructure and enterprise workflows at unprecedented scale,yet the lifecycle frameworks governing their development and operations were designed for operational efficiency rather than security analysis. As a result, security-relevant activities such as data provenance verification, artifact signing, agentic permission control, and decommissioning are often left implicit or assumed to receive due care. Governance frameworks, in turn, organise requirements around risk levels or management processes without clearly linking them to the lifecycle stages where they apply. This paper addresses both deficiencies. We propose a lifecycle model for LLM systems that supports security analysis by structuring it around security-relevant boundaries rather than workflow optimisation. The model comprises 32 stages across four core pipeline layers (Data, Model, Distribution, Application), supported by a 12-stage LLMOps pillar and a 9-category governance pillar. Thirteen stages are introduced here as separate units because they expose distinct security concerns that existing frameworks do not clearly distinguish. A governance mapping synthesising the NIST AI RMF, the EU AI Act, and ISO/IEC 42001 reveals a structural property of the current regulatory landscape: governance evidence concentrates at deployment-facing stages, where systems are visible to regulators, while the most consequential decisions, data selection, alignment strategy, and capability boundaries, are made at development-facing stages, where regulatory visibility is lowest.
2608.03626.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型正在以前所未有的規模整合進關鍵基礎設施和企業工作流程中，然而，管理其開發和運營的生命周期框架卻是為了操作效率而非安全分析而設計的。<lb/>因此，與安全相關的活動，如數據來源驗證、工件簽名、代理權限控制和退役，往往被隱含或假設會受到適當的關注。<lb/>治理框架則圍繞風險水平或管理流程組織要求，但未能明確將其與適用的生命周期階段聯繫起來。<lb/>本文針對這兩個缺陷進行了探討。<lb/>我們提出了一個支持安全分析的LLM系統生命周期模型，該模型圍繞安全相關邊界進行結構化，而非工作流程優化。<lb/>該模型由四個核心管道層（數據、模型、分發、應用）中的32個階段組成，並由一個12階段的LLMOps支柱和一個9類治理支柱支持。<lb/>這裡引入的十三個階段作為獨立單元，因為它們揭示了現有框架未能明確區分的獨特安全問題。<lb/>一個綜合NIST AI RMF、EU AI法案和ISO/IEC 42001的治理映射揭示了當前監管環境的一個結構性特徵：治理證據集中在面向部署的階段，這些階段中系統對監管機構可見，而最具影響力的決策，如數據選擇、對齊策略和能力邊界，則是在面向開發的階段做出的，這些階段的監管可見性最低。
